free_mem=$(grep MemFree /proc/meminfo | awk '{print $2}')
buff_mem=$(grep Buffers /proc/meminfo | awk '{print $2}')
cached_mem=$(grep "^Cached:" /proc/meminfo | awk '{print $2}')

# Calculate available memory (free + buffers + cached)
available_mem=$((free_mem + buff_mem + cached_mem))

# Calculate used memory
used_mem=$((total_mem - available_mem))

# Calculate percentage of used memory
if [ "$total_mem" -gt 0 ]; then
    percentage=$((used_mem * 100 / total_mem))
else
    percentage=0
fi

# Output the integer percentage
echo "$percentage"
EOF

cached_mem=$(grep "^Cached:" /proc/meminfo | awk '{print $2}')

    percentage=$((used_mem * 100 / total_mem))
else
    percentage=0
fi
